issues: Sheets 4-12: the B-cell grid is a block of near-identical dots with a faint orange column; the multiplying is shown as small orange dots above and below the column, so 'multiplying' barely reads and the viewer cannot tell cells from antibodies from copies.
Sheets 5-8: the explanatory line 'only the few whose shape fits respond' is tiny gray text that is unreadable on a phone and is not an on-screen element the viewer is guided to.

Sheets 7-12: at least 4 text layers compete at the top (B CELLS, MATCHING, MEMORY CELL) crammed against the grid with 'MEMORY CELL' set beside the grid edge in cramped caps; the memory cells are dark dots in the same column as the gray rest and are easy to miss.

Sheets 9-13: the lower half of the frame is empty for most of the video (about 8 s) while the diagram stays pinned to the top; the real germ circle later pops into this space with a large scale-in that overlaps the grid caption at 18.5 s.

Sheets 3-4 and 9: the yellow 'harmless piece' circle and 'real germ' circle are the same shape and color with no visual link to the vaccine, and the 'piece' is not shown entering the immune system; the idea of 'showing a piece of germ' is just a label in a blob.

Sheet 12: 'days, not weeks' fills the screen in huge type with no visual of fast versus slow; the response beat at 23.2 s (dots enlarging) is brief and the payoff is a text card that is not tied to the diagram.
Sheets 1-2: the opening is stacked text (A vaccine / shows your immune system) with a large empty middle for 3 s before any image appears.
